note: mpmath 1.4.1's special values that the multiprecision core already follows (William, Nov 10 2026: target 1.4.1, fix the known mpmath bugs) while this repository's references are still mpmath 1.3.0: CPython's mpmath==1.3.0 in CI (the fuzzer's reference) and the pinned pypi-mpmath 1.3.0 package (the python backend, conformance.py's reference). A comparison may pass a mismatch only when its case matches one rule below AND the core's value is that rule's exact 1.4.1 value; anything else stays a mismatch. Each rule's exact value is pinned on its own in test/mpcore-reimport.test.ts. REMOVED BY the pypi-mpmath 1.4.1 bump, which moves the references to 1.4.1 and deletes this file.

rules.rule: mpf_pow (1.4.1): 1**y is 1 and x**0 is 1 for y and x infinite or nan; mpmath 1.3.0 gives nan
mpc_sqrt (1.4.1): sqrt(x + i*inf) = inf + i*inf and sqrt(x - i*inf) = inf - i*inf for every x; mpmath 1.3.0 gives a nan imaginary part
mpc_div (1.4.1): a finite complex divided by a complex with an infinite part (and no nan) is 0; mpmath 1.3.0 gives nan + i*nan
